verdict.rationale: Namecheap runs an XML API endpoint, and its first-party Terraform provider manages DNS records programmatically, including one resource per record. That implies records can be created, updated and deleted through automation. However, the evidence never documents the API's DNS record methods directly or mentions ACME challenge use. Missing for 10: explicit API reference for create/update/delete record operations, documented per-record update/delete semantics, ACME/DNS-01 challenge support or examples, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, DNS records are CRUD-able via a documented API — create, update, and delete records programmatically for automation and ACME challenges

citations.quote: A Terraform Provider for Namecheap domain DNS configuration.
To manage records individually — one resource per record, so different owners can share a domain
you can use an update client to regularly update the IP Namecheap servers point to.
